queries.result: Burmese-language discovery identified the official SLRD site and general government land-form information, but no Kyaukpyu parcel map, anonymous ID-plus-geometry service, or local registry procedure page was exposed. The Yangon online land-form system lists only 33 Yangon townships and is not evidence for Kyaukpyu.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Myanmar Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD), whose official site describes the department and reports work based on its records and maps; this is national-agency evidence, not Kyaukpyu-local registry coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.surveyAgency: Myanmar Survey Department official site was identified as a national surveying source, but its public page did not yield a Kyaukpyu parcel service in this bounded review.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: No Kyaukpyu-specific local registry, cadastral map, public map viewer, or parcel procedure was evidenced. Therefore registryFound remains null.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official SLRD page was found through discovery. It identifies the Settlement and Land Records Department and references department records/maps and geodatabase analysis, but no Kyaukpyu parcel viewer or public parcel schema was exposed in the accessible page content. Direct curl received a Cloudflare challenge; no challenge was bypassed.

Official national Survey Department lead was found. A bounded anonymous GET timed out after 15 seconds from this environment; no retry escalation, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private token, or TLS exception was attempted. This is not evidence of service absence.

Official Yangon City Development Committee online land-form page was retrieved in Burmese. It lists map-copy and survey procedures but explicitly limits online availability to 33 Yangon townships; it does not cover Kyaukpyu and was not treated as a Kyaukpyu registry.
Official Yangon service lead identified during Burmese-language discovery; no Kyaukpyu-local coverage or public parcel-vector endpoint was established.
Myanmar National Portal appeared in English discovery with a Kyauk Phyu administrative contact listing, but no cadastral map, parcel API, or local land-record endpoint was exposed.

Further research may require a local office or a separate public service, but no credentials or unsafe fields were used.
